title: CIViC: Evidence Gates for Audio-Conditioned Visual Prediction on Proxy Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2610.15327v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Removing audio can shift a visual predictor's output without showing whether the task uses the intended audio information. We introduce Conditional Input and Visual Interpretation Checks (CIViC), a four-gate protocol that links an interpretation to an intervention, held-out task comparison, or endpoint control. We demonstrate CIViC on actor-disjoint face-raster tests, a synthetic audio-feature mixture, and source-video-disjoint SpeakerVid proxy tasks. In the static face-raster test, cross-actor audio replacement meets the registered detection rule with a small effect; on a separate temporal endpoint, constant-audio fits score better than audio-trained fits in four matched seeds. In the synthetic mixture, the condition-augmented fit has higher 1,000-step RMSE than the audio-only fit (0.1807 vs. 0.1707), with the gap shrinking during training. translated_abstract: 移除音频可能会改变视觉预测器的输出，但这并不能表明该任务是否真正使用了预期的音频信息。我们提出了条件输入与视觉解释检查（CIViC），这是一个四门控协议，它将解释与干预、留出任务比较或端点控制联系起来。我们在演员不相交的面部光栅测试、合成音频特征混合数据以及源视频不相交的SpeakerVid代理任务上演示了CIViC。在静态面部光栅测试中，跨演员音频替换以较小的效应量满足了预注册的检测规则；在另一个独立的时间端点上，恒定音频拟合在四个匹配的随机种子中的得分优于音频训练拟合。在合成混合实验中，条件增强拟合的1000步RMSE高于仅音频拟合（0.1807 对 0.1707），且两者差距在训练过程中逐渐缩小。在SpeakerVid代理任务中，五特征置零拟合（将五个低级音频摘要置零；id……（原文摘要此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出CIViC四门控验证协议，通过将解释与干预、留出任务比较或端点控制相绑定，来检验音频条件视觉预测任务是否真正使用了预期的音频信息，并在面部光栅测试、合成音频混合及SpeakerVid代理任务上验证了该方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CIViC, a four-gate protocol that links interpretations to interventions, held-out task comparisons, or endpoint controls to verify whether audio-conditioned visual prediction tasks genuinely use the intended audio information, demonstrated on face-raster tests, synthetic audio mixtures, and SpeakerVid proxy tasks.
